venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Friday 3/6.** Garden: slow start, first guests ~7; with nicer weather many stayed in the Garden rather than move inside; two bartenders worked well; phased out ~11, last call ~30 minutes later, cleared by midnight. D&C: slow start, bar filled ~6:30 and the floor 30 minutes later; short waitlist; cancellations filled with walk-ins and guests moving in; better bathroom checks and pre-bussing; room cleared a little after 2am; hit daily target. Kitchen: 9.29% of sales; Bread & Butter, Potatoes and Popcorn top sellers; note that oysters should be cleaned on arrival and perhaps not pre-shucked to avoid waste at EON. MOD: Kevin / Josh.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Friday 3/6.** Easy flow; front-heavy night with a slow close into the early hours; friends of Courtney in the last turn and a few larger parties kept energy up. Comps $123.32. Top sellers: Year of the Trees, First Time Listener, Masari. Door: no line but the bar was full at 7pm and most of the room; mix of pairs and larger parties; waitlist grew ~8pm; checked in first out-of-town D&C member (also an investor); lots of investors and well-paired solos; Haleigh's roommate Lexi, a DC manager, and Ken Young (Courtney's friend from Denver) visited; died ~11:30 but full until last call; accommodated out-of-towners who booked the wrong date. No-shows: Gideon Lazarus 10pm; B Johnson 11:45pm. Kitchen: none. (Guest check average entered as 0, not reported.)
